mapper.select:
SELECT spd.id, spd.create_user_id, spd.create_user_name, spd.create_time, spd.update_user_id, spd.update_user_name, spd.update_time, spd.version, spd.is_deleted, spd.sku_id, spd.main_id, spd.sku_no, spd.min_qty, spd.max_qty, spd.currency, spd.tax_price, spd.expire_date, spd.tax_rate, spd.effective_date, spd.disabled, spd.remark, sp.customer_id, sp.code AS priceCode, sp.so_org_name FROM so_price_detail spd inner join so_price sp on sp.id = spd.main_id and sp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE spd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND sp.id IN
#{soPriceId}
and sp.code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.priceCode}::text,'%')
